description: Read events from Apple Calendar for a day or period.

params.name: start
params.description: Start of the agenda period. Use YYYY-MM-DD for a local calendar day, or an ISO 8601 date-time with its time zone offset.

params.name: end
params.description: Exclusive end. Omit for a one-day agenda. Use YYYY-MM-DD for a local calendar day, or an ISO 8601 date-time with its time zone offset.
